{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01VGKyaUrSEAKRDWVZATEJfg","type":"tool_result","content":"//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity >=0.8.0 <0.9.0;\n\n// Useful for debugging. Remove when deploying to a live network.\nimport \"hardhat/console.sol\";\n\n// Use openzeppelin to inherit battle-tested implementations (ERC20, ERC721, etc)\n// import \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\n\n/**\n * A smart contract that allows changing a state variable of the contract and tracking the changes\n * It also allows the owner to withdraw the Ether in the contract\n * @author BuidlGuidl\n */\ncontract YourContract {\n    // State Variables\n    address public immutable owner;\n    string public greeting = \"Building Unstoppable Apps!!!\";\n    bool public premium = false;\n    uint256 public totalCounter = 0;\n    mapping(address => uint) public userGreetingCounter;\n\n    // Events: a way to emit log statements from smart contract that can be listened to by external parties\n    event GreetingChange(address indexed greetingSetter, string newGreeting, bool premium, uint256 value);\n\n    // Constructor: Called once on contract deployment\n    // Check packages/hardhat/deploy/00_deploy_your_contract.ts\n    constructor(address _owner) {\n        owner = _owner;\n    }\n\n    // Modifier: used to define a set of rules that must be met before or after a function is executed\n    // Check the withdraw() function\n    modifier isOwner() {\n        // msg.sender: predefined variable that represents address of the account that called the current function\n        require(msg.sender == owner, \"Not the Owner\");\n        _;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Function that allows anyone to change the state variable \"greeting\" of the contract and increase the counters\n     *\n     * @param _newGreeting (string memory) - new greeting to save on the contract\n     */\n    function setGreeting(string memory _newGreeting) public payable {\n        // Print data to the hardhat chain console. Remove when deploying to a live network.\n        console.log(\"Setting new greeting '%s' from %s\", _newGreeting, msg.sender);\n\n        // Change state variables\n        greeting = _newGreeting;\n        totalCounter += 1;\n        userGreetingCounter[msg.sender] += 1;\n\n        // msg.value: built-in global variable that represents the amount of ether sent with the transaction\n        if (msg.value > 0) {\n            premium = true;\n        } else {\n            premium = false;\n        }\n\n        // emit: keyword used to trigger an event\n        emit GreetingChange(msg.sender, _newGreeting, msg.value > 0, msg.value);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Function that allows the owner to withdraw all the Ether in the contract\n     * The function can only be called by the owner of the contract as defined by the isOwner modifier\n     */\n    function withdraw() public isOwner {\n        (bool success, ) = owner.call{ value: address(this).balance }(\"\");\n        require(success, \"Failed to send Ether\");\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Function that allows the contract to receive ETH\n     */\n    receive() external payable {}\n}","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bbba1c6f-1de5-4bb7-a7fe-6b57839bf913","uuid":"ba78a3e9-cca8-47a7-a4ed-6c1bc9753bc4","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:26:40.048Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity >=0.8.0 <0.9.0;\n\n// Useful for debugging. \"../rocketh/deploy.js\";\n\n/**\n * Deploys a contract named \"YourContract\" using the deployer account and\n * constructor arguments set to the deployer address\n *\n * @param env Rocketh environment object.\n */\nexport default deployScript(\n  async env => {\n    /*\n      On localhost, the deployer account is the one that comes with Hardhat, which is already funded.\n\n      When deploying to live networks (e.g `yarn deploy --network sepolia`), the deployer account\n      should have sufficient balance to pay for the gas fees for contract creation.\n\n      You can generate a random account with `yarn generate` or `yarn account:import` to import your\n      existing PK which will fill DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY_ENCRYPTED in the .env file (then used on hardhat.config.ts)\n      You can run the `yarn account` command to check your balance in every network.\n    */\n    const { deployer } = env.namedAccounts;\n\n    const yourContract = await env.deploy(\"YourContract\", {\n      account: deployer,\n      artifact: artifacts.YourContract,\n      // Contract constructor arguments\n      args: [deployer],\n    });\n\n    // Read back from the deployed contract\n    const {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01L5T9ctqD7d4kphr3kjUBhD","type":"tool_result","content":"---\nname: openzeppelin\ndescription: \"Develop smart contracts using OpenZeppelin Contracts library. Use when the user wants to create or modify Solidity contracts that use OpenZeppelin — including token standards (ERC20, ERC721, ERC1155), access control (Ownable, AccessControl), security primitives (Pausable, ReentrancyGuard), or any OZ extension. Covers library-first integration, pattern discovery from installed source, and version-safe development.\"\n---\n\n# Develop Smart Contracts with OpenZeppelin\n\nAdapted from [OpenZeppelin's official skill](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-skills) for Scaffold-ETH 2 Solidity projects.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\nCheck if `./packages/nextjs/scaffold.config.ts` exists directly in the current working directory (do not search subdirectories). If it doesn't exist, this is not a Scaffold-ETH 2 project. Follow the instructions at https://docs.scaffoldeth.io/SKILL.md to scaffold it first. If it exists, continue directly with building.\n\nDetect the Solidity framework flavor:\n- If `packages/hardhat` exists → **Hardhat flavor**\n- If `packages/foundry` exists → **Foundry flavor**\n\n## Core Principle: Prefer Library Components Over Custom Code\n\nBefore writing ANY contract logic, search the installed OpenZeppelin library for an existing component:\n\n1. **Exact match exists?** Import and use it directly — inherit, override only what's needed\n2. **Close match exists?** Import and extend — override only functions the library marks as `virtual`\n3. **No match?** Only then write custom logic. Confirm by browsing the library's directory first\n\n**Never hand-write what the library already provides:**\n- Don't write `require(totalSupply() + amount <= cap)` when `ERC20Capped` exists\n- Don't write `require(msg.sender == owner)` when `Ownable` exists\n- Don't implement token transfer hooks manually when the library's base contracts handle it\n- Don't copy library source into your contract — always import from the dependency so the project gets security updates\n\n## Pattern Discovery: Read the Installed Source\n\nAPIs, override points, and import syntax change between major versions. Don't assume patterns from memory — always verify by reading the installed source.\n\n### Step 1: Identify the installed version and browse the library\n\nFind the OpenZeppelin version and locate the installed source:\n\n- **Hardhat**: check `packages/hardhat/package.json` for `@openzeppelin/contracts` version, then browse `packages/hardhat/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/`\n- **Foundry**: check `packages/foundry/lib/openzeppelin-contracts/` and the remappings in `packages/foundry/foundry.toml`\n\nBrowse the library's directory structure to discover available components. Key directories inside the OZ contracts root:\n- `token/{ERC20,ERC721,ERC1155}/` — token standards and their base implementations\n- `token/{ERC20,ERC721}/extensions/` — Capped, Burnable, Pausable, Permit, Votes, Enumerable, etc.\n- `access/` — Ownable, AccessControl, AccessManager\n- `utils/` — ReentrancyGuard, Pausable, math, structs\n\n### Step 2: Read the source file for the component you need\n\nLook at:\n- **Import syntax**: how the library's own files import each other — mirror that style. OZ v5+ uses named imports:\n  ```solidity\n  // ✅ import {ERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n  // ❌ import \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n  ```\n- **`virtual` functions**: only these can be overridden. Functions that were virtual in one version may not be in another\n- **Constructor parameters**: what must be passed during deployment\n- **NatSpec comments**: `NOTE: This function is not virtual, {X} should be overridden instead` — follow these\n\n### Step 3: Extract the minimal integration pattern\n\nFrom the source, identify only what's needed:\n- Imports to add\n- Inheritance chain\n- Constructor parameters and chaining\n- Required overrides (when inheriting multiple contracts that define the same virtual function, you must override it and call `super`)\n- New functions to expose\n\n### Step 4: Apply to the user's contract\n\nIntegrate into existing code. Check for conflicts: duplicate access control, incompatible inheritance, missing overrides. The Solidity compiler will error if two parent contracts define the same function and you don't explicitly override it.\n\n## SE-2 Integration Notes\n\n- OpenZeppelin is pre-installed in both flavors — no additional dependency installation needed\n- Contracts: `packages/hardhat/contracts/` (Hardhat) or `packages/foundry/contracts/` (Foundry)\n- Deploy scripts: `packages/hardhat/deploy/` (Hardhat) or `packages/foundry/script/` (Foundry)\n- Frontend reads contract ABIs from `packages/nextjs/contracts/deployedContracts.ts` (auto-generated by `yarn deploy`)","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bbba1c6f-1de5-4bb7-a7fe-6b57839bf913","uuid":"941d46cb-9618-4598-bc11-378d78d797c7","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:27:08.657Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"---\nname: openzeppelin\ndescription: \"Develop smart contracts using OpenZeppelin Contracts library. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_018rZXTm2GfungTAkXhu3GLK","type":"tool_result","content":"===useScaffoldWriteContract===\nimport { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\nimport { MutateOptions } from \"@tanstack/react-query\";\nimport { Abi, ExtractAbiFunctionNames } from \"abitype\";\nimport { Config, UseWriteContractParameters, useAccount, useConfig, useWriteContract } from \"wagmi\";\nimport { WriteContractErrorType, WriteContractReturnType } from \"wagmi/actions\";\nimport { WriteContractVariables } from \"wagmi/query\";\nimport { useSelectedNetwork } from \"~~/hooks/scaffold-eth\";\nimport { useDeployedContractInfo, useTransactor } from \"~~/hooks/scaffold-eth\";\nimport { AllowedChainIds, notification } from \"~~/utils/scaffold-eth\";\nimport {\n  ContractAbi,\n  ContractName,\n  ScaffoldWriteContractOptions,\n  ScaffoldWriteContractVariables,\n  UseScaffoldWriteConfig,\n  simulateContractWriteAndNotifyError,\n} from \"~~/utils/scaffold-eth/contract\";\n\ntype ScaffoldWriteContractReturnType<TContractName extends ContractName> = Omit<\n  ReturnType<typeof useWriteContract>,\n  \"writeContract\" | \"writeContractAsync\"\n> & {\n  isMining: boolean;\n  writeContractAsync: <\n    TFunctionName extends ExtractAbiFunctionNames<ContractAbi<TContractName>, \"nonpayable\" | \"payable\">,\n  >(\n    variables: ScaffoldWriteContractVariables<TContractName, TFunctionName>,\n    options?: ScaffoldWriteContractOptions,\n  ) => Promise<WriteContractReturnType | undefined>;\n  writeContract: <TFunctionName extends ExtractAbiFunctionNames<ContractAbi<TContractName>, \"nonpayable\" | \"payable\">>(\n    variables: ScaffoldWriteContractVariables<TContractName, TFunctionName>,\n    options?: Omit<ScaffoldWriteContractOptions, \"onBlockConfirmation\" | \"blockConfirmations\">,\n  ) => void;\n};\n\nexport function useScaffoldWriteContract<TContractName extends ContractName>(\n  config: UseScaffoldWriteConfig<TContractName>,\n): ScaffoldWriteContractReturnType<TContractName>;\n/**\n * @deprecated Use object parameter version instead: useScaffoldWriteContract({ contractName: \"YourContract\" })\n */\nexport function useScaffoldWriteContract<TContractName extends ContractName>(\n  contractName: TContractName,\n  writeContractParams?: UseWriteContractParameters,\n): ScaffoldWriteContractReturnType<TContractName>;\n\n/**\n * Wrapper around wagmi's useWriteContract hook which automatically loads (by name) the contract ABI and address from\n * the contracts present in deployedContracts.ts & externalContracts.ts corresponding to targetNetworks configured in scaffold.config.ts\n * @param contractName - name of the contract to be written to\n * @param config.chainId - optional chainId that is configured with the scaffold project to make use for multi-chain interactions.\n * @param writeContractParams - wagmi's useWriteContract parameters\n */\nexport function useScaffoldWriteContract<TContractName extends ContractName>(\n  configOrName: UseScaffoldWriteConfig<TContractName> | TContractName,\n  writeContractParams?: UseWriteContractParameters,\n): ScaffoldWriteContractReturnType<TContractName> {\n  const finalConfig =\n    typeof configOrName === \"string\"\n      ? { contractName: configOrName, writeContractParams, chainId: undefined }\n      : (configOrName as UseScaffoldWriteConfig<TContractName>);\n  const { contractName, chainId, writeContractParams: finalWriteContractParams } = finalConfig;\n\n  const wagmiConfig = useConfig();\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (typeof configOrName === \"string\") {\n      console.warn(\n        \"Using `useScaffoldWriteContract` with a string parameter is deprecated. Please use the object parameter version instead.\",\n      );\n    }\n  }, [configOrName]);\n\n  const { chain: accountChain } = useAccount();\n  const writeTx = useTransactor();\n  const [isMining, setIsMining] = useState(false);\n\n  const wagmiContractWrite = useWriteContract(finalWriteContractParams);\n\n  const selectedNetwork = useSelectedNetwork(chainId);\n\n  const { data: deployedContractData } = useDeployedContractInfo({\n    contractName,\n    chainId: selectedNetwork.id as AllowedChainIds,\n  });\n\n  const sendContractWriteAsyncTx = async <\n    TFunctionName extends ExtractAbiFunctionNames<ContractAbi<TContractName>, \"nonpayable\" | \"payable\">,\n  >(\n    variables: ScaffoldWriteContractVariables<TContractName, TFunctionName>,\n    options?: ScaffoldWriteContractOptions,\n  ) => {\n    if (!deployedContractData) {\n      notification.error(\"Target Contract is not deployed, did you forget to run `yarn deploy`?\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (!accountChain?.id) {\n      notification.error(\"Please connect your wallet\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (accountChain?.id !== selectedNetwork.id) {\n      notification.error(`Wallet is connected to the wrong network. Please switch to ${selectedNetwork.name}`);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      setIsMining(true);\n      const { blockConfirmations, onBlockConfirmation, ...mutateOptions } = options || {};\n\n      const writeContractObject = {\n        abi: deployedContractData.abi as Abi,\n        address: deployedContractData.address,\n        ...variables,\n      } as WriteContractVariables<Abi, string, any[], Config, number>;\n\n      if (!finalConfig?.disableSimulate) {\n        await simulateContractWriteAndNotifyError({\n          wagmiConfig,\n          writeContractParams: writeContractObject,\n          chainId: selectedNetwork.id as AllowedChainIds,\n        });\n      }\n\n      const makeWriteWithParams = () =>\n        wagmiContractWrite.writeContractAsync(\n          writeContractObject,\n          mutateOptions as\n            | MutateOptions<\n                WriteContractReturnType,\n                WriteContractErrorType,\n                WriteContractVariables<Abi, string, any[], Config, number>,\n                unknown\n              >\n            | undefined,\n        );\n      const writeTxResult = await writeTx(makeWriteWithParams, { blockConfirmations, onBlockConfirmation });\n\n      return writeTxResult;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      throw e;\n    } finally {\n      setIsMining(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const sendContractWriteTx = <\n    TContractName extends ContractName,\n    TFunctionName extends ExtractAbiFunctionNames<ContractAbi<TContractName>, \"nonpayable\" | \"payable\">,\n  >(\n    variables: ScaffoldWriteContractVariables<TContractName, TFunctionName>,\n    options?: Omit<ScaffoldWriteContractOptions, \"onBlockConfirmation\" | \"blockConfirmations\">,\n  ) => {\n    if (!deployedContractData) {\n      notification.error(\"Target Contract is not deployed, did you forget to run `yarn deploy`?\");\n      return;\n    }\n    if (!accountChain?.id) {\n      notification.error(\"Please connect your wallet\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (accountChain?.id !== selectedNetwork.id) {\n      notification.error(`Wallet is connected to the wrong network. Please switch to ${selectedNetwork.name}`);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    wagmiContractWrite.writeContract(\n      {\n        abi: deployedContractData.abi as Abi,\n        address: deployedContractData.address,\n        ...variables,\n      } as WriteContractVariables<Abi, string, any[], Config, number>,\n      options as\n        | MutateOptions<\n            WriteContractReturnType,\n            WriteContractErrorType,\n            WriteContractVariables<Abi, string, any[], Config, number>,\n            unknown\n          >\n        | undefined,\n    );\n  };\n\n  return {\n    ...wagmiContractWrite,\n    isMining,\n    // Overwrite wagmi's writeContactAsync\n    writeContractAsync: sendContractWriteAsyncTx,\n    // Overwrite wagmi's writeContract\n    writeContract: sendContractWriteTx,\n  };\n}\n===useScaffoldReadContract===\nimport { useEffect } from \"react\";\nimport { QueryObserverResult, RefetchOptions, useQueryClient } from {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdLVXnQLkzNUATojcMmhg","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01WvUBFzZep4kRBGkAMKjtnQ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-ux-goal-001/2026-07-24T072626Z-claude-no-skill-1/workspace/packages/hardhat/contracts/Staker.sol","content":"//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.30;\n\nimport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport { SafeERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n\n/**\n * Minimal USDC staking vault.\n *\n * Users deposit USDC and can withdraw their full position at any time. There is\n * no rewards logic, no lockup, and no admin — the contract only ever holds what\n * stakers deposited and only ever pays it back to them.\n *\n * The token is fixed at deployment and assumed to be a standard, non-rebasing,\n * non-fee-on-transfer ERC20 (USDC on Base). Accounting credits the requested\n * amount on deposit; a fee-on-transfer token would break that invariant.\n *\n * @author BuidlGuidl\n */\ncontract Staker {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    /// The staked token (USDC, 6 decimals on Base).\n    IERC20 public immutable usdc;\n\n    /// Staked balance per user, denominated in USDC's smallest unit.\n    mapping(address => uint256) public stakedBalance;\n\n    /// Total USDC held on behalf of all stakers.\n    uint256 public totalStaked;\n\n    event Staked(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n\n    error ZeroAmount();\n    error NothingStaked();\n\n    constructor(IERC20 _usdc) {\n        usdc = _usdc;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Deposit `amount` of USDC into the vault. Caller must approve this contract\n     * for at least `amount` beforehand.\n     */\n    function stake(uint256 amount) external {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n\n        // Effects before interaction (checks-effects-interactions).\n        stakedBalance[msg.sender] += amount;\n        totalStaked += amount;\n\n        usdc.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n\n        emit Staked(msg.sender, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// Withdraw the caller's entire staked position back to their wallet.\n    function withdraw() external {\n        uint256 amount = stakedBalance[msg.sender];\n        if (amount == 0) revert NothingStaked();\n\n        stakedBalance[msg.sender] = 0;\n        totalStaked -= amount;\n\n        usdc.safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);\n\n        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, amount);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":850,"cache_read_input_tokens":78741,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":850},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bbba1c6f-1de5-4bb7-a7fe-6b57839bf913","uuid":"35f2f97b-c1a3-4ac1-ba26-0057fcc312db","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:32:08.521Z","request_id":"req_011CdLVXmHsKSMhuHjP8frf5"}

Exposes an unrestricted `mint` so\n * developers can fund any test account — this is why it must NEVER be deployed to\n * a live network.\n */\ncontract MockUSDC is ERC20 {\n    constructor() ERC20(\"USD Coin\", \"USDC\") {}\n\n    /// USDC uses 6 decimals, not the ERC20 default of 18.\n    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {\n        return 6;\n    }\n\n    /// Freely mint test tokens to any address.\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        _mint(to, amount);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":850,"cache_read_input_tokens":78741,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":850},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bbba1c6f-1de5-4bb7-a7fe-6b57839bf913","uuid":"df295c40-959e-4f9b-8f2a-838f604112f1","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:32:13.075Z","request_id":"req_011CdLVXmHsKSMhuHjP8frf5"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdLVZRy5WLDeZN118HvnJ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01LeerNriJCcDBR1B8FXBvLj","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-ux-goal-001/2026-07-24T072626Z-claude-no-skill-1/workspace/packages/hardhat/deploy/00_deploy_staker.ts","content":"import { deployScript, artifacts } from \"../rocketh/deploy.js\";\n\n/**\n * Canonical USDC addresses per chain. On these networks the Staker points at the\n * real token; on any other (local) network a faithful mock is deployed instead.\n *\n * Sources: https://developers.circle.com/stablecoins/usdc-on-main-networks\n */\nconst USDC_BY_CHAIN: Record<number, `0x${string}`> = {\n  8453: \"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913\", // Base mainnet\n  84532: \"0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e\", // Base Sepolia\n};\n\n// 1,000,000 USDC (6 decimals) seeded to the deployer on local networks.\nconst LOCAL_MINT_AMOUNT = 1_000_000_000_000n;\n\n/**\n * Deploys the Staker contract wired to USDC.\n *\n * - Known networks (Base / Base Sepolia): reuse the real USDC token.\n * - Local / unknown networks: deploy MockUSDC and seed the deployer so the app\n *   is immediately usable end-to-end.\n */\nexport default deployScript(\n  async env => {\n    const { deployer } = env.namedAccounts;\n    const chainId = env.network.chain.id;\n\n    let usdcAddress = USDC_BY_CHAIN[chainId];\n\n    if (!usdcAddress) {\n      const mockUsdc = await env.deploy(\"USDC\", {\n        account: deployer,\n        artifact: artifacts.MockUSDC,\n        args: [],\n      });\n      usdcAddress = mockUsdc.address;\n\n      await env.execute(mockUsdc, {\n        functionName: \"mint\",\n        args: [deployer, LOCAL_MINT_AMOUNT],\n        account: deployer,\n      });\n\n      console.log(\"🪙 Deployed MockUSDC and seeded deployer at\", usdcAddress);\n    } else {\n      console.log(\"🪙 Using real USDC at\", usdcAddress);\n    }\n\n    await env.deploy(\"Staker\", {\n      account: deployer,\n      artifact: artifacts.Staker,\n      args: [usdcAddress],\n    });\n  },\n  {\n    tags: [\"Staker\"],\n  },\n);\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":582,"cache_read_input_tokens":81436,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":582},"output_tokens":54,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bbba1c6f-1de5-4bb7-a7fe-6b57839bf913","uuid":"faca9ec8-069d-4f96-a518-daf4b23038b3","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:32:32.053Z","request_id":"req_011CdLVZPPYoqFAo8LHY1Mba"}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01HVTSWsL8BqAoEH95XNax15","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n2\tpragma solidity 0.8.30;\n3\t\n4\timport { IERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n5\timport { SafeERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n6\t\n7\t/**\n8\t * Minimal USDC staking vault.\n9\t *\n10\t * Users deposit USDC and can withdraw their full position at any time. There is\n11\t * no rewards logic, no lockup, and no admin — the contract only ever holds what\n12\t * stakers deposited and only ever pays it back to them.\n13\t *\n14\t * The token is fixed at deployment and assumed to be a standard, non-rebasing,\n15\t * non-fee-on-transfer ERC20 (USDC on Base). Accounting credits the requested\n16\t * amount on deposit; a fee-on-transfer token would break that invariant.\n17\t *\n18\t * @author BuidlGuidl\n19\t */\n20\tcontract Staker {\n21\t    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n22\t\n23\t    /// The staked token (USDC, 6 decimals on Base).\n24\t    IERC20 public immutable usdc;\n25\t\n26\t    /// Staked balance per user, denominated in USDC's smallest unit.\n27\t    mapping(address => uint256) public stakedBalance;\n28\t\n29\t    /// Total USDC held on behalf of all stakers.\n30\t    uint256 public totalStaked;\n31\t\n32\t    event Staked(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n33\t    event Withdrawn(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n34\t\n35\t    error ZeroAmount();\n36\t    error NothingStaked();\n37\t\n38\t    constructor(IERC20 _usdc) {\n39\t        usdc = _usdc;\n40\t    }\n41\t\n42\t    /**\n43\t     * Deposit `amount` of USDC into the vault. Caller must approve this contract\n44\t     * for at least `amount` beforehand.\n45\t     */\n46\t    function stake(uint256 amount) external {\n47\t        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n48\t\n49\t        // Effects before interaction (checks-effects-interactions).\n50\t        stakedBalance[msg.sender] += amount;\n51\t        totalStaked += amount;\n52\t\n53\t        usdc.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n54\t\n55\t        emit Staked(msg.sender, amount);\n56\t    }\n57\t\n58\t    /// Withdraw the caller's entire staked position back to their wallet.\n59\t    function withdraw() external {\n60\t        uint256 amount = stakedBalance[msg.sender];\n61\t        if (amount == 0) revert NothingStaked();\n62\t\n63\t        stakedBalance[msg.sender] = 0;\n64\t        totalStaked -= amount;\n65\t\n66\t        usdc.safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount);\n67\t\n68\t        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, amount);\n69\t    }\n70\t}\n71\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_016tGo5t7ceSnefJybcCFpiD","session_id":"bbba1c6f-1de5-4bb7-a7fe-6b57839bf913","uuid":"bf1f987f-14e9-4e55-b636-c69be916f910","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:46:48.119Z","subagent_type":"grumpy-carlos-code-reviewer","task_description":"Review staking dApp code"}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01B9wYhPdxTC4JqqN6hUzwmM","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n2\tpragma solidity 0.8.30;\n3\t\n4\timport { ERC20 } from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n5\t\n6\t/**\n7\t * Mock USDC for local development only.\n8\t *\n9\t * Mirrors the real token's name, symbol, and 6-decimal precision so the frontend\n10\t * behaves identically against a local chain. Exposes an unrestricted `mint` so\n11\t * developers can fund any test account — this is why it must NEVER be deployed to\n12\t * a live network.\n13\t */\n14\tcontract MockUSDC is ERC20 {\n15\t    constructor() ERC20(\"USD Coin\", \"USDC\") {}\n16\t\n17\t    /// USDC uses 6 decimals, not the ERC20 default of 18.\n18\t    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {\n19\t        return 6;\n20\t    }\n21\t\n22\t    /// Freely mint test tokens to any address.\n23\t    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n24\t        _mint(to, amount);\n25\t    }\n26\t}\n27\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_016tGo5t7ceSnefJybcCFpiD","session_id":"bbba1c6f-1de5-4bb7-a7fe-6b57839bf913","uuid":"3850a53d-0424-4a0c-b053-10137a88cfd3","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:46:49.639Z","subagent_type":"grumpy-carlos-code-reviewer","task_description":"Review staking dApp code"}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01UDsV3d4kdsgrrzqW2K8rfM","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\n2\timport { useIsMounted } from \"usehooks-ts\";\n3\timport { usePublicClient } from \"wagmi\";\n4\timport { useSelectedNetwork } from \"~~/hooks/scaffold-eth\";\n5\timport {\n6\t  Contract,\n7\t  ContractCodeStatus,\n8\t  ContractName,\n9\t  UseDeployedContractConfig,\n10\t  contracts,\n11\t} from \"~~/utils/scaffold-eth/contract\";\n12\t\n13\ttype DeployedContractData<TContractName extends ContractName> = {\n14\t  data: Contract<TContractName> | undefined;\n15\t  isLoading: boolean;\n16\t};\n17\t\n18\t/**\n19\t * Gets the matching contract info for the provided contract name from the contracts present in deployedContracts.ts\n20\t * and externalContracts.ts corresponding to targetNetworks configured in scaffold.config.ts\n21\t */\n22\texport function useDeployedContractInfo<TContractName extends ContractName>(\n23\t  config: UseDeployedContractConfig<TContractName>,\n24\t): DeployedContractData<TContractName>;\n25\t/**\n26\t * @deprecated Use object parameter version instead: useDeployedContractInfo({ contractName: \"YourContract\" })\n27\t */\n28\texport function useDeployedContractInfo<TContractName extends ContractName>(\n29\t  contractName: TContractName,\n30\t): DeployedContractData<TContractName>;\n31\t\n32\texport function useDeployedContractInfo<TContractName extends ContractName>(\n33\t  configOrName: UseDeployedContractConfig<TContractName> | TContractName,\n34\t): DeployedContractData<TContractName> {\n35\t  const isMounted = useIsMounted();\n36\t\n37\t  const finalConfig: UseDeployedContractConfig<TContractName> =\n38\t    typeof configOrName === \"string\" ? { contractName: configOrName } : (configOrName as any);\n39\t\n40\t  useEffect(() => {\n41\t    if (typeof configOrName === \"string\") {\n42\t      console.warn(\n43\t        \"Using `useDeployedContractInfo` with a string parameter is deprecated. Please use the object parameter version instead.\",\n44\t      );\n45\t    }\n46\t  }, [configOrName]);\n47\t  const { contractName, chainId } = finalConfig;\n48\t  const selectedNetwork = useSelectedNetwork(chainId);\n49\t  const deployedContract = contracts?.[selectedNetwork.id]?.[contractName as ContractName] as Contract<TContractName>;\n50\t  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ContractCodeStatus>(ContractCodeStatus.LOADING);\n51\t  const publicClient = usePublicClient({ chainId: selectedNetwork.id });\n52\t\n53\t  useEffect(() => {\n54\t    const checkContractDeployment = async () => {\n55\t      try {\n56\t        if (!isMounted() || !publicClient) return;\n57\t\n58\t        if (!deployedContract) {\n59\t          setStatus(ContractCodeStatus.NOT_FOUND);\n60\t          return;\n61\t        }\n62\t\n63\t        const code = await publicClient.getBytecode({\n64\t          address: deployedContract.address,\n65\t        });\n66\t\n67\t        // If contract code is `0x` => no contract deployed on that address\n68\t        if (code === \"0x\") {\n69\t          setStatus(ContractCodeStatus.NOT_FOUND);\n70\t          return;\n71\t        }\n72\t        setStatus(ContractCodeStatus.DEPLOYED);\n73\t      } catch (e) {\n74\t        console.error(e);\n75\t        setStatus(ContractCodeStatus.NOT_FOUND);\n76\t      }\n77\t    };\n78\t\n79\t    checkContractDeployment();\n80\t  }, [isMounted, contractName, deployedContract, publicClient]);\n81\t\n82\t  return {\n83\t    data: status === ContractCodeStatus.DEPLOYED ? deployedContract : undefined,\n84\t    isLoading: status === ContractCodeStatus.LOADING,\n85\t  };\n86\t}\n87\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_016tGo5t7ceSnefJybcCFpiD","session_id":"bbba1c6f-1de5-4bb7-a7fe-6b57839bf913","uuid":"34269b67-7c87-4a34-842e-3040fb21faa3","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:48:03.327Z","subagent_type":"grumpy-carlos-code-reviewer","task_description":"Review staking dApp code"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdLWqFZZpaTYFipBYY46T","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've reviewed all eight files plus the relevant SE-2 hooks to ground my analysis. The Solidity is genuinely solid (CEI ordering, SafeERC20, immutable token, correct full-withdraw accounting), so most findings are on the frontend/config side. Findings are prioritized below.\n\n## Findings\n\n### HIGH\n\n**1. Production config ships `hardhat` as the default network — unconnected users and users on unsupported chains get a fully broken page.**\n`packages/nextjs/scaffold.config.ts:24` — `targetNetworks: [chains.hardhat, chains.base]`.\n\n`useTargetNetwork.ts:9` confirms the selected network defaults to `targetNetworks[0]` whenever the wallet is disconnected or on a chain not in the list. Since `hardhat` is first:\n- A real user landing on `/stake` **before connecting** (or connected to, say, Ethereum mainnet) resolves `targetNetwork = hardhat`. Every `useScaffoldReadContract` then points at `http://localhost:8545`, which doesn't exist in prod → Wallet USDC / Staked show `…` forever and the \"Staker is not deployed on Hardhat\" warning renders. First impression is a broken app.\n- The in-app network switcher exposes `localhost` as a selectable production network.\n\nThe inline comment rationalizes this (\"until Staker is deployed to Base, hardhat stays first\"), but as delivered this is the shipped state for a dApp that \"goes in front of real users.\" This should be gated: deploy Staker to Base, then ship `targetNetworks: [chains.base]` (hardhat only in local dev). Side effect worth noting: because `base` is present, `burnerWalletMode: \"localNetworksOnly\"` (line 47) disables the burner wallet even during local development, since not *all* target networks are local.\n\nAlso note the comment's premise (\"SE-2 derives contract types from `targetNetworks[0]`, so the first must contain every contract\") is inaccurate — `contracts` is merged across all configured chains — so it isn't a real reason to keep hardhat first.\n\n### MEDIUM\n\n**2. Allowance-loading race shows \"Stake\" before the approval state is known → wasted, reverting tx.**\n`packages/nextjs/app/stake/page.tsx:69` and `:181-207`.\n\n`needsApproval = allowance !== undefined && parsedAmount > 0n && allowance < parsedAmount`. During the window where the `allowance` read hasn't resolved yet (`allowance === undefined`), `needsApproval` is `false`, so the primary button renders as **\"Stake\"** and is enabled once an amount is typed. A user who types and clicks quickly on first visit fires `stake()` with zero allowance → on-chain revert (`ERC20InsufficientAllowance`) and a scary error notification. Once allowance resolves to `0` it flips to \"Approve\" correctly, so it's a first-interaction race, but for a money app it's worth gating the button on `allowance !== undefined` (treat \"unknown allowance\" as \"not ready\", not \"stake\").\n\n**3. Staker constructor has no zero-address check.**\n`packages/hardhat/contracts/Staker.sol:38-40`. `constructor(IERC20 _usdc)` accepts `address(0)`. The deploy script currently guards this, but since the token is `immutable`, a bad deploy arg permanently bricks the contract with no recovery. A one-line `if (address(_usdc) == 0) revert` is cheap insurance for a contract that will hold real user funds.\n\n### LOW / NITS\n\n**4. Funds sent directly to the Staker (not via `stake`) are permanently unrecoverable.** `Staker.sol` has no admin/sweep. This is an acceptable tradeoff for the intentionally trustless/minimal design, but worth a one-line note in the NatSpec so it's a conscious decision. USDC's blacklist/upgradeability can also freeze an individual staker's `withdraw` — inherent to USDC, not fixable here.\n\n**5. Display precision via `Number(formatUnits(...))`.** `page.tsx:65` routes balances through JS `Number` for `toLocaleString`. Fine for realistic USDC magnitudes (well under 2^53), but it's a lossy path in a financial UI; acceptable for display-only.\n\n**6. Post-approve lag.** After a successful `approve`, `needsApproval` stays `true` until the `allowance` read refetches on the next block (`useScaffoldReadContract` watch default), so the button remains \"Approve\" for a few seconds and there's no auto-advance to \"Stake.\" Minor UX friction, not a bug.\n\n**7. Unused external entry.** `externalContracts.ts:117-122` defines USDC for Base Sepolia (84532), which isn't in `targetNetworks`. Harmless, but dead config.\n\n## What's correct (so it isn't re-litigated)\n- `Staker.sol` follows checks-effects-interactions, uses `SafeERC20`, isolates per-user balances, and returns the full position — matches the spec. Tests in `test/Staker.ts` cover deposit, isolation, zero-amount, insufficient-allowance, full-withdraw, and nothing-staked.\n- Deploy script (`00_deploy_staker.ts`) correctly reuses real USDC on 8453/84532 and deploys+seeds `MockUSDC` (named `\"USDC\"`) elsewhere, so the frontend's `contractName: \"USDC\"` resolves on both local and Base.\n- `MockUSDC` correctly overrides `decimals()` to 6 and is clearly marked dev-only.\n- The `/stake` page satisfies the display requirements (wallet USDC, staked position, ETH-for-gas via `Balance`) and gracefully handles the not-yet-deployed Staker case, and the Header link is wired correctly.\n\nKey files: `packages/nextjs/scaffold.config.ts:24`, `packages/nextjs/app/stake/page.tsx:69`, `packages/hardhat/contracts/Staker.sol:38`."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4391,"cache_read_input_tokens":31630,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":4391,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_016tGo5t7ceSnefJybcCFpiD","session_id":"bbba1c6f-1de5-4bb7-a7fe-6b57839bf913","uuid":"8ecb7003-2800-4b81-8727-eff99c05a5af","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:50:00.966Z","request_id":"req_011CdLWqBvnhC4qJupG5Ka81","subagent_type":"grumpy-carlos-code-reviewer","task_description":"Review staking dApp code"}

Accounting credits the requested\n * amount on deposit; a fee-on-transfer token would break that invariant.\n *\n * @author BuidlGuidl\n */\ncontract Staker {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    /// The staked token (USDC, 6 decimals on Base).\n    IERC20 public immutable usdc;\n\n    /// Staked balance per user, denominated in USDC's smallest unit.\n    mapping(address => uint256) public stakedBalance;\n\n    /// Total USDC held on behalf of all stakers.\n    uint256 public totalStaked;\n\n    event Staked(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n\n    error ZeroAmount();\n    error NothingStaked();\n\n    constructor(IERC20 _usdc) {\n        usdc = _usdc;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Deposit `amount` of USDC into the vault. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdLXHXEcmF2x1NFHcjTWm","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QTjZV5cmVFDWP26XBmSFZA","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/.claude/projects/-Users-liana-Documents-prog-buidl-guidl-ethskills-evals-artifacts-frontend-ux-goal-001-2026-07-24T072626Z-claude-no-skill-1-workspace/memory/se2-contractname-from-target0.md","content":"---\nname: se2-contractname-from-target0\ndescription: SE-2 derives the ContractName type union from targetNetworks[0], not the merge of all chains\nmetadata:\n  type: reference\n---\n\nIn this Scaffold-ETH 2 repo, `packages/nextjs/utils/scaffold-eth/contract.ts` computes\n`ConfiguredChainId = targetNetworks[0][\"id\"]` and `Contracts = ContractsDeclaration[ConfiguredChainId]`.\nSo the **typed** `ContractName` union (what `useScaffoldReadContract`/`useScaffoldWriteContract` accept)\ncomes only from the FIRST target network — even though the runtime `contracts` object is merged across all chains.\n\nConsequence: the first network in `scaffold.config.ts` `targetNetworks` must contain EVERY contract you\nreference through the typed hooks, or `tsc` fails with `Type '\"Foo\"' is not assignable to type ...`.\n\nVerified empirically: putting `chains.base` first while `Staker` was only in `deployedContracts` on 31337\nbroke `check-types` for every `contractName: \"Staker\"` call. Keeping `chains.hardhat` first (it has Staker +\nmock USDC) fixed it. To make Base the default network, you must first deploy Staker to Base so\n`deployedContracts[8453].Staker` exists, then reorder.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1138,"cache_read_input_tokens":170558,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1138},"output_tokens":57,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bbba1c6f-1de5-4bb7-a7fe-6b57839bf913","uuid":"1a9b4fa8-0ffb-4b4c-a771-b4a74757b199","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:55:05.095Z","request_id":"req_011CdLXHUkJLUHTr3bnACCuF"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdLXJNLrwdi1XXg7eqFGs","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Done. The USDC staking dApp is built, tested, and builds cleanly.\n\n## What I built\n\n**Contracts** (`packages/hardhat/contracts/`)\n- **`Staker.sol`** — minimal vault. `stake(amount)` pulls USDC (via `SafeERC20`, checks-effects-interactions), `withdraw()` returns the caller's full position. Immutable token, per-user `stakedBalance`, `totalStaked`, `Staked`/`Withdrawn` events, custom errors, and a constructor zero-address guard. No rewards, no admin, no sweep (documented as deliberate).\n- **`MockUSDC.sol`** — dev-only mock faithful to real USDC (name/symbol, 6 decimals) with an open `mint` faucet.\n\n**Deploy** (`00_deploy_staker.ts`) — uses the real USDC on Base (`0x8335…2913`) and Base Sepolia; on any other chain deploys the mock (named `USDC`) and seeds the deployer, so the frontend's `contractName: \"USDC\"` resolves everywhere.\n\n**Tests** — 8 passing (deposit, isolation, zero-amount, insufficient-allowance, full-withdraw, nothing-staked, zero-address deploy). `tsc` clean.\n\n**Frontend**\n- **`/stake` page** — wallet USDC balance, staked position, ETH-for-gas (`Balance` component), a two-step approve→stake flow with a Max button, and full-position withdraw. Handles disconnected wallet and \"Staker not deployed on this network\" gracefully.\n- `externalContracts.ts` (Base USDC ABI), Header nav link, and `scaffold.config.ts` targeting Base + hardhat.\n\n**Verification:** contracts compile, 8 tests pass, both packages typecheck, `yarn build` succeeds with `/stake`, lint has 0 errors (remaining warnings are pre-existing baseline formatting), and my files are prettier-clean.\n\n## One production follow-up (important)\n`targetNetworks` currently lists **`[hardhat, base]`** with hardhat first. This is *required* right now: SE-2 derives the typed `ContractName` union from `targetNetworks[0]`, and Staker only exists in `deployedContracts` on the local chain — I verified that putting Base first fails `tsc`. Before going live: **deploy Staker to Base** (`yarn deploy --network base`), which adds `deployedContracts[8453].Staker`, then reorder to `[chains.base]` only. Until then, a disconnected prod visitor would default to the hardhat network — so that reorder is the gating step before real users hit the page. I left a comment at `scaffold.config.ts:24` spelling this out.\n\nThe code review also flagged an allowance-loading race (fixed: the button never shows \"Stake\" before allowance is known) and the zero-address guard (added)."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1138,"cache_read_input_tokens":171696,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1138},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bbba1c6f-1de5-4bb7-a7fe-6b57839bf913","uuid":"b7ad82e0-f03a-45ba-8a3f-30bff60456b0","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:55:21.114Z","request_id":"req_011CdLXJL6BRBgcBhLxSHkLY"}

No rewards, no admin, no sweep (documented as deliberate).\n- **`MockUSDC.sol`** — dev-only mock faithful to real USDC (name/symbol, 6 decimals) with an open `mint` faucet.\n\n**Deploy** (`00_deploy_staker.ts`) — uses the real USDC on Base (`0x8335…2913`) and Base Sepolia; on any other chain deploys the mock (named `USDC`) and seeds the deployer, so the frontend's `contractName: \"USDC\"` resolves everywhere.\n\n**Tests** — 8 passing (deposit, isolation, zero-amount, insufficient-allowance, full-withdraw, nothing-staked, zero-address deploy). `tsc` clean.\n\n**Frontend**\n- **`/stake` page** — wallet USDC balance, staked position, ETH-for-gas (`Balance` component), a two-step approve→stake flow with a Max button, and full-position withdraw. Handles disconnected wallet and \"Staker not deployed on this network\" gracefully.\n- `externalContracts.ts` (Base USDC ABI), Header nav link, and `scaffold.config.ts` targeting Base + hardhat.\n\n**Verification:** contracts compile, 8 tests pass, both packages typecheck, `yarn build` succeeds with `/stake`, lint has 0 errors (remaining warnings are pre-existing baseline formatting), and my files are prettier-clean.\n\n## One production follow-up (important)\n`targetNetworks` currently lists **`[hardhat, base]`** with hardhat first. This is *required* right now: SE-2 derives the typed `ContractName` union from `targetNetworks[0]`, and Staker only exists in `deployedContracts` on the local chain — I verified that putting Base first fails `tsc`. Before going live: **deploy Staker to Base** (`yarn deploy --network base`), which adds `deployedContracts[8453].Staker`, then reorder to `[chains.base]` only. Until then, a disconnected prod visitor would default to the hardhat network — so that reorder is the gating step before real users hit the page. I left a comment at `scaffold.config.ts:24` spelling this out.\n\nThe code review also flagged an allowance-loading race (fixed: the button never shows \"Stake\" before allowance is known) and the zero-address guard (added).","ttft_ms":3066,"ttft_stream_ms":2070,"time_to_request_ms":28,"type":"result","duration_ms":1733200,"uuid":"bf155ce2-59c1-4de6-9de9-0dbeb4e9ca0a"}
